sheets.title: 07 — VASE À ROSES
sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE detailed production concept reference sheet for a redesigned videogame prop from the catalogue. Input1 shows existing prop identity, to thoughtfully REDESIGN (not trace its simplistic shapes); final input shows approved shop art direction/layout. Match this bold outlined 2D Rick and Morty inspired cartoon visual language, flat colors and subtle cel shadows, pleasing slightly quirky geometry, no photorealism or realistic flower textures. High quality warm ivory landscape sheet with clean rounded panel grid and French titles. SAME object geometry and design in all views, modeling-ready. Include aligned true orthographic FACE, DOS, PROFIL, DESSUS, larger assembled TROIS-QUARTS, 2-3 enlarged useful construction details and palette swatches. Minimal accurate annotations. Show open mouths, thicknesses and connections clearly. Redesign must be visibly more refined, with meaningful silhouette, layered edges, material joins and restrained botanical detail, not noise. No environment, characters, faces, brands, watermarks, unrelated props. This is a proposed design sheet for later 3D modeling, not a screenshot. Title exact: "07 — VASE À ROSES". Subject: Replace plain tapered glass cup with small elegant transparent pale-aqua glass bud vase: rounded pear-like lower body, slightly narrowed neck, gently flared rolled rim, stable thick circular foot; six broad subtle vertical flutes around lower belly, single small ivory collar tied with simple dusty-rose ribbon (short two tails, no giant bow). Keep contents exactly THREE strongly cartoon roses red, pink and ivory with green leaves and stems from input, chunky lobed spiral petals. Overall arranged height about0.38m, vesselheight0.16m maximumdiameter0.105m. Clearly separate removable flowers from vessel. Main orthographic row focuses on EMPTY VASE at same scale to expose shape, with assembled bouquet three-quarter and a small arranged front view. DESSUS must show actual open rim/cavity not a solid cap. Construction detail rim section and flutes, ribbon fastening. Stylized glass transparency, no realistic refraction.
